baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction joins تَرْمِى, شَرَر, and the simile كَٱلْقَصْرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Casting gives the fire particles directed force, while the palace branch supplies bounded monumental scale. The simile therefore enlarges each discrete spark into an architectural projectile rather than merely describing a bright spray.

activation_trace.role: Physical throwing supplies the directed launch that makes the sparks projectiles.
Flying fire particles supply the literal objects being launched.
The enclosed monumental building supplies both enormous scale and a sharply bounded silhouette.

changed_reading.before: The referent emits unusually large sparks.
changed_reading.after: It launches discrete, palace-scale masses of fire as directed projectiles.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The outward action of تَرْمِى is set against the confinement image available in قَصْر, with شَرَر as what breaks loose.
baseline_models.mechanism: Throwing moves material outward; the shredding branch of the spark root supplies cutting and shaking loose; and the qasr branches supply confinement and enclosed structure. Together they permit a material reading in which punishment ruptures containment and ejects building-sized fragments.

activation_trace.role: Throwing supplies outward displacement from a source.
Shredding and shaking loose recast the sparks as violently detached fragments.
Confinement supplies the bounded state from which material is expelled.
The enclosed building gives the expelled fragments architectural mass.

changed_reading.before: The palace comparison is only a measure of spark size.
changed_reading.after: The image also stages enclosure failing under pressure and leaving as monumental debris.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَرْمِى names motion, while branches of ر م ي and ق ص ر converge on measure, endpoint, and failure to stop within a limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The projectile can be read temporally as well as spatially: it progresses to a terminal point, exceeds measure, and meets the qasr tension between falling short and being the utmost limit. The spark then marks a violent arrival at a boundary, not only an object of a certain size.

activation_trace.role: Progressing to a limit supplies a terminal trajectory for the cast spark.
Exceeding measure makes the projectile an event of dangerous overshoot.
The literal flying spark keeps the endpoint model attached to the focus image.
The utmost limit supplies the terminus toward which the casting runs.
Falling short of an endpoint keeps a live counter-pressure between arrival and failure.

changed_reading.before: The verse freezes a spark beside a large visual comparator.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also be heard as a trajectory driven to, or violently beyond, its terminal measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places threat, occurrence, appointed time, deferred term, and measured limit in one sequence. That sequence strengthens the focus-only endpoint model: the cast sparks become the punctual material delivery of something promised and calibrated, not random overflow.

activation_trace.role: Progress toward a limit anchors the focus action as terminal motion.
Flying sparks remain the literal units in which the terminal event arrives.
The utmost limit turns the architectural comparison into an endpoint marker as well as a scale marker.
A promise fixed to time or place supplies the scheduled content awaiting delivery.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the transition from promise to realized impact.
Definition by a time or limit supplies explicit calibration of the event.
The fixed end of a term supplies the deferred boundary finally reached.
A magnitude reaching its prescribed limit supplies measured rather than accidental scale.

structural_cues: 77:7 states promised occurrence, 77:11-13 appoint and defer it to a day, and 77:22-23 repeat measure before the focus scene.
The focus imperfect تَرْمِى presents the appointed event as active, repeated delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promise-to-term sequence and limit branches; I infer that the sparks are the sequence's delivered units. A live alternative is that the timing frames the judgment globally without specifying the sparks as its delivery mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sparks are uncontrolled emissions whose scale is hyperbolic.
changed_reading.after: They are calibrated impacts arriving at the term and measure already established by the surah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation passage repeatedly supplies secure placement, gathering, and fixation. Against those holding operations, the focus reverses the qasr from an enclosure that keeps material in place into a monumental unit thrown outward. The punishment image becomes anti-habitat: ordered containment is replaced by pressured decontainment.

activation_trace.role: Throwing supplies the outward reversal of secure placement.
Shredding and shaking loose supply the material released when containment fails.
Confinement anchors the bounded state that the casting reverses.
The enclosed monumental building gives the failed container architectural scale.
Fixity and settlement supply the first secure holding operation.
A place of being supplies a located interior in which development can remain.
Gathering and gripping within a receptacle supplies earth as a comprehensive container.
Firm fixation supplies the stable mass that contrasts with airborne architectural fragments.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 progresses from fluid placed in a secure location to earth gathering living and dead and mountains fixed upon it.
After the refrain, 77:29-32 replaces placement with compelled motion and violent outward casting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated containers and fixed masses followed by outward motion; I infer a designed reversal from keeping to ejecting. The main alternative is that qasr contributes size alone and the containment contrast belongs only to the wider sequence.

changed_reading.before: A source throws sparks comparable in size to palaces.
changed_reading.after: The scene reverses the surah's secure containers: enclosure itself fails and exits as weaponized monumental matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context first offers an overhead, branching form but denies it shade and protection from flame. The focus reveals that this apparent canopy generates palace-scale missiles. Later, actual shade is paired with protection and springs, so the qasr-like grandeur reads as counterfeit architecture: it looks sheltering but attacks its occupants.

activation_trace.role: Physical casting turns the overhead form from cover into an attacking source.
Flying sparks are the harmful output that disproves the promise of shade.
The enclosed monumental building supplies the deceptive appearance of habitable protection.
An overhead canopy supplies the apparent shelter immediately above the focus image.
Splitting and branching give the canopy the form of a divided flame plume.
The tongue and ignition of fire identify the canopy's active source as flame.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the criterion the earlier pseudo-shade fails.
A flowing spring supplies the cooling life-support paired with genuine shade.

structural_cues: 77:30-32 is one uninterrupted movement from command, to three-branched shade, to negated protection, to sparks.
77:41 repeats shade for the protected group and pairs it with springs rather than flame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a false overhead form, flame, and a later protected shade; I infer that the palace image intensifies a counterfeit-shelter reversal. Alternatively, the palace may mark only spark size while the two shade scenes carry the contrast independently.

changed_reading.before: The palace simile communicates only spectacular magnitude.
changed_reading.after: Palatial form becomes an anti-shelter: apparent architecture overhead manufactures the projectiles that make it uninhabitable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following simile overlays a gathered camel mass and yellow coloration on the palace-sized sparks. This revises a static-block reading into a moving collective: monumental units arrive serially or in a herd-like surge, with yellow or copper-like visual force.

activation_trace.role: Throwing supplies motion to the monumental units.
Flying sparks supply the multiple moving units.
The monumental building supplies each unit's mass before the next simile animates the collection.
A gathered camel collective converts isolated architecture into a coordinated moving multitude.
An aggregate whole reinforces that the sparks are perceived as a mass, not one object.
Yellow coloration supplies the collective's visible fire-lit surface.
Copper supplies a live metallic-color variant for the monumental moving mass.

structural_cues: 77:32 and 77:33 form consecutive كـ/كَأَنَّ comparisons of the same masculine singular image target.
The first comparison supplies scale and bounded shape; the second supplies collectivity and color.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a camel collective, aggregation, and yellow/copper branches; I infer serial motion and swarm behavior from their attachment to a thrown plural mass. The alternative is a purely visual comparison of shape and color with no implied collective motion.

changed_reading.before: Each spark resembles a static monumental block.
changed_reading.after: The monumental sparks move as a yellow, gathered multitude, combining architecture's mass with a herd's kinetic pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context opens the upper enclosure and uproots solid mountains; the creation passage then recalls mountains as fixed and lofty. The focus continues that mass-transfer logic by making architecture airborne. Palace-scale sparks are not merely big: they are a terminal world in which formerly stable monumental forms have become projectiles.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the conversion of monumental mass into airborne threat.
Flying fire supplies the new mobile state of the mass.
The monumental enclosure supplies a human-built counterpart to the displaced cosmic masses.
Opening a gap between two sides supplies the failure of the upper enclosure.
An elevated solid mass supplies the natural monument that normally resists motion.
Uprooting and removal supply the operation that dislodges stable mass.
Flying residue supplies a direct material analogue for monumental matter becoming airborne.
Fixity supplies the normal condition reversed by uprooting and casting.
Mountain height supplies the vertical scale shared by mountains, palaces, and the airborne fire masses.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 applies passive transformations to stars, sky, and mountains before the active casting in 77:32.
77:27 briefly restores the image of fixed lofty mountains, sharpening the later reversal into airborne monumentality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened enclosure, uprooted mountains, fixed lofty mountains, and a cast palace comparison; I infer one architecture-of-instability sequence. Alternatively, the cosmic transformations and the palace simile may share scale without sharing a material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sparks are compared to a familiar large building.
changed_reading.after: They complete a surah-wide destabilization in which sky, mountain, and built enclosure lose fixity and monumental mass flies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence repeatedly alternates spreading, separating, and gathering. Applied to the focus's material branches, the qasr is the gathered bounded whole and the sparks are its separated, shaken-loose pieces. The simile thus compresses both states of matter into one line: aggregate monument and dispersed fragments.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the dispersive force applied to the bounded whole.
Shredding and shaking loose supply the focus's fragmentation operation.
The enclosed monument supplies the aggregate state before dispersion.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the first dispersive operation in the surah.
Scattering into parts supplies an explicit decomposition parallel to sparks breaking loose.
Separation that exposes a boundary supplies judicial and material differentiation.
Joining dispersed things into a whole supplies the inverse operation and the qasr-like aggregate state.

structural_cues: 77:3-4 opens with spreading followed by separating, while 77:38 places separation and gathering in the same ayah.
The focus line itself moves from a plural particulate noun to a singular bounded comparator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated inverse operations of dispersion and collection; I infer that they organize the focus image materially. A live alternative is that those operations govern proclamation and judgment while the focus comparison remains only visual.

changed_reading.before: Plural sparks happen to be compared with one kind of large object.
changed_reading.after: The plural sparks and singular palace encode dispersed and gathered states of the same violent mass.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface nouns strongly favor literal sparks and a palace, while the model uses a non-dominant split mapping and distant weather branches. It remains anchored in all three focus roots: cloudlike casting, spreading lightning, and mingling darkness. Downstream prose should present it only as a storm-form echo enriching the fire image, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus alone permits ر م ي as a cloud casting pieces, the split ش ر ر mapping as spreading lightning, and ق ص ر as mingling darkness.

activation_trace.role: A cloud arriving as thrown pieces or heavy drops supplies the mass from which luminous fragments issue.
Spreading and flashing lightning supplies a sky-scale analogue for flying sparks.
Mingling darkness supplies the surrounding stormlike field against which the flashes emerge.

changed_reading.before: The scene is only combustion ejecting solid-looking embers.
changed_reading.after: A contained storm echo appears within the combustion: a dark mass casts lightning-like pieces on an architectural scale.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from physical fire into discourse and assigns rhetorical agency to the scene. It remains anchored in the focus's accusation, quarrel, and restricted-address branches, and context repeatedly supplies denial before withdrawing speech and excuse. Downstream prose should call it a materialized-reply overlay, never the lexical sense of شَرَر or the sole referent of تَرْمِى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verbal-casting branch of تَرْمِى, the quarrel branch of شَرَر, and the specially restricted address branch of قَصْر remain attached to the focus words.

activation_trace.role: Casting accusation in speech supplies the focus-side bridge from projectile to utterance.
Quarreling supplies adversarial exchange within the spark root without displacing its literal fire sense.
Speech restricted to a particular group supplies the image of an answer confined to its addressees.
Attributing something to falsehood supplies the preceding hostile speech act.
Speech and articulation supply the faculty explicitly absent after the focus scene.
Permission to act supplies the authorization withheld from any verbal response.
Excuse and apology supply the blocked defensive utterance.
Voiced command supplies an earlier verbal summons that was not answered in action.
Heart-settling assent supplies the final response whose absence the surah questions.

changed_reading.before: The fire spectacle follows denial but does not itself participate in discourse.
changed_reading.after: As a contained rhetorical overlay, the thrown sparks become the material counter-utterance after denial, before human speech and excuse are shut down.

strongest_changes: The palace image changed from a scale marker into a container whose failure ejects monumental matter.
The false three-branched shade and later protected shade changed the qasr-like grandeur into counterfeit shelter.
Promise, timing, term, and measure changed apparently uncontrolled sparks into calibrated terminal delivery.
The following camel-and-yellow image changed static architectural blocks into a moving collective.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made a short visual line participate in repeated operations: secure holding versus ejection, gathering versus separation, fixed measure versus terminal arrival, and false versus effective protection. The split ش ر ر inventory also preserved storm and discourse echoes that a literal-only synthesis would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The palace branch is lexically strongest for قَصْر; endpoint, confinement, and darkness may color the image without becoming concurrent senses.
The mobile-collective reading depends on how much motion the camel comparison contributes beyond shape and color.
The storm-front and materialized-speech outliers may be branch echoes rather than intended mechanisms and require explicit qualification.
The inferred links from contextual operations to the focus's material behavior are coherent but are reader-supplied arrows, not explicit causal statements in the packet.
